_comment: Strings the site needs and the app has no use for.
Deliberately here rather than in lib/l10n/*.arb: every one of these labels
a control that only exists in a browser, and putting them in the ARB would
ship them inside the app to be translated, reviewed and carried forever
tool/build_site.dart merges these over the ARB when it writes the site's
strings.<lang>.json, so the browser sees one table and the app's own
translations stay the single source for everything the two share.
